summary: Iteration 415 — regression-tested the 4 user-selected tasks across web + mobile. WEB WeeklyBudget recorded-entries CRUD (Add Entry/Edit/Delete) all work end-to-end against /api/fundtrack/participants/{pid}/charges (POST 200), /api/fundtrack/charges/{id} (PATCH 200, DELETE 200); search, sort, source filter still function; date column shows full date incl. year ('Sunday 22 November 2026'). WEB dark mode readable across dashboard hero text, three coloured tiles (teal/red/clay with white text), care-management/shortfall notes, quarter pill, gold donut arc, FundtrackAlerts, and the WeeklyBudget action buttons (weekly-add-charge teal rgb(26,105,110), weekly-whatif red rgb(200,90,60), weekly-something-changed clay rgb(217,138,78) — all with white text, none pale). Light mode has no regressions. AskWaylyV2 typing dots wiring verified in code. MOBILE weekly-budget heading 'What You Have Recorded This Quarter' is Title Case, source labels Title Case ('You Entered'), Edit opens edit-entry-sheet → PATCH 200, Delete + confirm → DELETE 200, row disappears. MOBILE Ask Wayly shows aw2-typing dots immediately after send (250ms check passed), dots hide after reply, tab bar hidden, suggestions hide on send, back button present, composer at bottom. No red screens, no critical regressions.

issues: Date rendered as 'Sunday 22 November 2026' (no comma after weekday). Spec example used 'Sunday, 22 November 2026'. Full date incl. year IS present so acceptance condition is met; punctuation is a minor UX nit — consider adding the comma for consistency with the spec example.

Row date shows short format '22/11/2026'. Not a spec violation (mobile brief did not require long date), but lacks parity with web's 'Sunday 22 November 2026'. Consider a compact long form on mobile (e.g. '22 Nov 2026') for consistency.
Service names in list render in sentence case (e.g. 'Personal care, morning'). Spec only required SOURCE labels to be Title Case (they are — 'You Entered'), so this is informational, not a defect.

parity_issues.issue: Web shows long date with weekday + year ('Sunday 22 November 2026'); mobile shows short '22/11/2026'.
parity_issues.expected: Consistent date presentation across surfaces (long format on both, per the WEB spec example)
parity_issues.actual: Different date formats web vs mobile

action_items: (Optional, minor) Add comma after weekday in WEB WeeklyBudget date column to match spec example — 'Sunday, 22 November 2026'.
(Optional, minor) Align mobile weekly-budget row date format with web long date (e.g. '22 Nov 2026') for cross-surface parity.
critical_code_review_comments: AskWaylyV2 web renders TypingDots only when `streaming && !msg.content`. Fast backends can skip the visible flicker (as in this run); wiring is correct. Consider enforcing a minimum display time (e.g. 300ms) so the dots are always perceivable even on fast replies.
